name: asksvin-lead-rope
description: D-144 (T-014): on foot, E on the saddle chest rope of a saddled Asksvin takes it by the rope (toggle); standing close in front of the rope backs it up (half its walk speed, facing ahead), standing further off leads it forward, E again lets go. (A Mobile Cannon is placed only because the Asksvin spawn hook puts the animal beside one; it is not hitched.)

steps.name: GunPowdered.playerBeforeRope
steps.label: stand in front of the chest rope

steps.name: GunPowdered.ropeFirstHit
steps.label: looking at the chest from 2 m in front, the rope is what the look hits first (not the body)

steps.name: GunPowdered.asksvinLead
steps.regex: lead sent True, rope at .*Lead \(walk into it
steps.label: E on the chest rope: the hover offers Lead, the request is sent
GameProbe shot: led backwards by the chest rope

steps.name: GunPowdered.asksvinBackState
steps.regex: back (0\.[5-9]\d|[1-9]\.\d\d) m, max back speed .*ratio 0\.([3-6]\d|7[0-5])\), turned -?([0-9]|1[0-9]) deg, backing seen True
steps.label: it backed up at about half its walk speed, facing the player

steps.name: GunPowdered.playerBeforeRope
steps.label: walk off in front of it

steps.name: GunPowdered.asksvinBackState
steps.label: it followed forward on the rope
